Interpretation guardrails

  • A concentration at sample index modulo 512 is an observed capture periodicity, not proof of the firmware's internal block size.
  • Raw/pre-SHF controls help localize the point at which an artifact appears.
  • The native-16-kHz control distinguishes a 48-kHz-path-specific failure from a general microphone/capture failure.
  • Audio is played by an independent host output; the XVF far-end/AEC playback path is intentionally not used.
